events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Fenerbahce 1, Slavia Prague 0. Oguz Aydin (Fenerbahce) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Milan Skriniar.
Goal! Fenerbahce 2, Slavia Prague 0. Mason Greenwood (Fenerbahce) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Nélson Semedo.
Goal! Fenerbahce 2, Slavia Prague 1. Lukás Provod (Slavia Prague) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Nathan Aké (Fenerbahce).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Kojo Peprah Oppong replaces Nathan Aké because of an injury.
N'Golo Kanté (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
